cards.title: Where we come from
cards.body:
Johnson & Johnson was founded in 1886 in New Brunswick, New Jersey, by three brothers – Robert Wood, James Wood and Edward Mead Johnson. Their first big idea was to make surgery safer with ready-to-use sterile dressings, at a time when infections after operations were common.

That focus on making care safer and better has guided the company ever since.

cards.title: Johnson & Johnson today
cards.body: Today Johnson & Johnson is a healthcare company focused on two areas:
bullets: Innovative Medicine – medicines for areas such as oncology, immunology and neuroscience.
MedTech – technologies and devices used by surgeons, cardiologists, eye-care professionals and hospitals.
The consumer health business was separated in 2023 and now operates as an independent company (Kenvue).

cards.title: What connects us
cards.body: Whatever our role, we share one purpose: to change the trajectory of health for humanity. In MedTech that means helping clinicians treat patients with less invasive, more precise and more personalised procedures.

milestones.title: The company is founded
milestones.text: Three Johnson brothers start the company in New Brunswick, New Jersey, to produce sterile surgical dressings.

milestones.title: First commercial first-aid kits
milestones.text: Early first-aid kits bring ready-to-use supplies to railway workers and, later, families.

milestones.title: Our Credo is written
milestones.text: Robert Wood Johnson, chairman and son of a founder, writes Our Credo – the values statement that still guides the company.

milestones.title: Ethicon is established
milestones.text: Suture-making becomes a dedicated business – the start of today's Surgery portfolio.

milestones.title: Disposable contact lenses
milestones.text: ACUVUE introduces one of the first disposable soft contact lenses, shaping today's Vision business.

milestones.title: DePuy Synthes
milestones.text: The acquisition of Synthes is combined with DePuy to form a broad orthopaedics business.

milestones.title: Abiomed joins
milestones.text: Heart-recovery technology, including very small heart pumps, joins the Cardiovascular portfolio.

milestones.title: A focused healthcare company
milestones.text: Consumer Health separates as Kenvue. The company now focuses on Innovative Medicine and MedTech.

milestones.title: Shockwave Medical joins
milestones.text: Intravascular lithotripsy expands Cardiovascular into coronary and peripheral artery disease.

milestones.title: Orthopaedics separation announced
milestones.text: J&J announces its intent to separate the Orthopaedics business as a standalone company operating as DePuy Synthes.

milestones.title: Business-unit-led MedTech
milestones.text: J&J MedTech moves to a business-unit-led operating model worldwide.

checkpoint.question: Which two areas does Johnson & Johnson focus on today?
checkpoint.explanation: Since the separation of Consumer Health (Kenvue) in 2023, J&J focuses on Innovative Medicine and MedTech.
